# Pidan Panel
Pidan Panel is beginner-friendly and ideal for those looking to boost efficiency without the hassle.
> [!IMPORTANT]
> Please note that we are currently in an internal testing phase (alpha); this does not mean the system is unusable, but the documentation and code may be unstable or incomplete.

The code is not currently open source; further information will be released later.
If you have any questions, issues, or feature requests, please create an issue!

**To improve efficiency, some code was generated by AI and has not undergone 100% manual review.**

I am working on improving this issue; it will be resolved in the beta.

## Features
- Beginner-friendly (You need to have basic knowledge.)
- Automatic check: checks the system for faults and provides notifications.
- Visualization of resource usage
- Visual File Management
- Optimized visual change configuration file
- Fully visual configuration for most game settings.
- Audit logs
- Basic permission management: allows you to restrict users to managing only specific instances.
- AND MORE!

> Please offer your suggestions; this is important!
